Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. Kyle Coetzer and George Munsey are the openers for Scotland. Tendai Chatara to get us underway with the ball.
... THE RUN CHASE...

Right then! Scotland have to get 137 runs from 20 overs and by doing so they will also clinch the T20I series! Zimbabwe, on the other hand, will have to be at their best both with the ball and in the field as it is a do-or-die encounter for them, and they do not have much runs to play with either.

The Scottish bowlers were up to the mark once again as all the bowlers stuck to their plans and executed them nicely. Safyaan Sharif was exceptional with the ball but he went wicket-less this time around. The spinners also kept Zimbabwean batters in check and hardly gave any loose balls. Overall, it was a good bowling effort from the hosts, but they would feel that they missed out on a trick after taking crucial wickets upfront.

The visitors did not start well with the bat and lost 3 wickets in the Powerplay. Craig Ervine and Sean Williams steadied the ship and stitched together a crucial partnership of 71 runs, before the former got out on 30. Sean Williams played a brilliant knock of an unbeaten 60 for his side and helped Zimbabwe to put up some sort of a respectable total of 136 on the board.
This has been a pretty good comeback from Zimbabwe after losing early wickets in the Powerplay. The hosts would be a tad disappointed as they gave away some freebies in the end.
In the slot, around off. Burl mistimes it to extra cover and they get just one. Zimbabwe END WITH 136/5!
A yorker this time, on middle. Sean Williams can't get under it and manages to heave it down to deep mid-wicket for a single. They think about the second but decide against it in the end.
Fuller delivery, on the stumps. Burl looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads and the ball goes nowhere. They sneak in a quick run.
FOUR! Full, but on the pads. Burl clips it past short fine leg and the ball races away into the fence.
Nicely disguised slower ball from Safyaan Sharif. On a length and on leg stump. Ryan Burl doesn't pick it up again and misses.
On the pads and Williams gets down on one knee again. This time he gets an inside edge to deep backward square leg for one.
Mandatory concussion check. Ryan Burl is hit on the grill of the helmet and the physio is out to have a look. Burl is fine and we are ready for the final over.
A quick bumper, on middle. Ryan Burl looks to pull but misses and the ball hits him on the helmet. Hope he is fine.
FOUR! A touch short and wide, Ryan Burl thrashes at it. He manages to clear the off side field as the ball goes over backward point and into the fence.
Length ball, outside off and played to wide long off for a single.
FOUR! On leg stump and Sean Williams gets down on one knee and then just helps it over backward square leg for a boundary.
LEG BYE! A slower length ball, on leg stump. Burl doesn't pick it up and is through his slog early. He misses and gets hit on the thigh pad. They do get a leg bye.
Full and outside off, Sean Williams creams it to wide long off for just a single.
Alasdair Evans to bowl the penultimate over.
Good-length ball, around off. Williams bottom-edges it back onto the deck and sneaks in the single.
Length ball, on middle and worked towards deep mid-wicket by Williams. He comes back for the second and brings up a gutsy half-century. This one can prove very important in the context of this match.
A yorker this time, on middle and leg. Burl digs it out to long on and gets a run.
This one is on the pads and Sean Williams flicks it to deep square leg for another one.
Good-length ball, around off. Burl steers it to backward point for a quick single.
Length ball, on top of off. Williams wrists it to deep mid-wicket and picks up a run.
Safyaan Sharif comes in to replace Gavin Main.
On a length, around off. Sean Williams works it down the ground and collects a single. 11 runs from the over!
Short ball, turning away late. Ryan Burl pushes it towards long off for a run.
Flatter ball, on middle and leg. Sean Williams turns it towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
SIX! BANG! Sean Williams breaks the shackles! Tossed up, on middle. Sean Williams gets low and slog sweeps it over the deep mid-wicket region for a maximum! Zimbabwe needs more of those!
Quicker ball, outside off. Sean Williams cuts it again but finds the backward point fielder.
Flatter ball, outside off. Sean Williams hangs back and cuts it hard through extra cover for a couple.
FOUR LEG BYES! Main drifts onto the pads and Burl looks to tuck it fine. The ball comes off the thigh pads and beats short fine leg and races away to the boundary.
WIDE! Length ball, pushed wider and going across the left-hander. Burl leaves it alone and a wide is called.
Good-length ball, on off stump. Kept out by Burl.

OUT! CAUGHT! Milton Shumba is a goner and that is a big wicket for Scotland as Shumba was devastating in the previous match. Length ball, around off and Shumba frees his arms. He looks to go over extra cover but hits it straight down the throat of Alasdair Evans at mid-off who takes a sharp catch. Ryan Burl comes out to bat now.
Commentary.Howout: c Alasdair Evans b Gavin Main

Commentary.Commentary: Length ball, on off and Sean Williams looks to slog it over mid-wicket but just closes the face of the bat too early and the ball goes to long on. They get another single.
Fullish ball, on off. Shumba swats it to long on for a run.
Full and way outside off. Shumba leaves it alone, but its just inside the tramline.
Leg bye! Flighted ball, down leg. Milton Shumba misses the sweep and gets hit on the pads. The batters take a leg bye!
Tossed up, on off. Milton Shumba taps it towards cover.
Milton Shumba is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! That is a huge wicket for Scotland. Leask serves a loopy ball, around off. Craig Ervine makes room to go over extra cover but he only manages a thick outside edge and the ball goes straight to Kyle Coetzer at backward point who pouches it with ease. Michael Leask provides his team with an important breakthrough!
Commentary.Howout: c Kyle Coetzer b Michael Leask

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up, outside off. Sean Williams miscues the sweep shot as the ball goes towards the long on fielder. The batters take one.
Flatter ball, on off. Craig Ervine eases it down the ground for a run.
Tossed up, outside off. Craig Ervine looks to reverse sweep but gets a top edge towards short third man.
Michael Leask is back into the attack.
A quick bumper this time, on middle and Williams looks to pull. He takes his eyes off the ball and the ball hits him on the body.
Length ball, on middle. Ervine bunts it towards mid on and gets the single.
On off and pushed to mid off for a single.

SAFE! Fullish ball, on middle and Williams taps it back onto the deck. Craig Ervine is way out of the batting crease and scampers to get back. The bowler misses the shy at the stumps and Ervine survives. Huge let-off!
On a length, around middle and leg. Ervine tucks it away toward mid-wicket for another quick single.
Full ball, on off and bunted on the off side for a run.
Alasdair Evans is brought back into the attack.
Flighted ball, on leg. Sean Williams tucks it round the corner and collects a single.
FOUR! SMASHED! Short ball, down leg. Sean Williams rocks back and slashes it hard through square leg for a boundary.
Flatter ball, on middle. Craig Ervine flicks it towards fine leg for a run.
Two wides! Sprayed down leg. The keeper fails to collect the ball and they take a run.
Flighted ball, on off. Sean Williams defends it out.
Tossed up, down leg. Sean Williams whips it towards deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Tossed up, on middle. Craig Ervine flicks it towards mid-wicket and takes a quick run.
Good-length ball, on off and played through cover for a single.
On the pads again and flicked to deep square leg for one.
Length ball, on middle and pushed down the ground for a run.
FOUR! Cheeky shot from Craig Ervine. On leg stump and just flicked over backward square leg and into the fence.
On middle and leg, worked to deep mid-wicket for another one.
Bowling Change. Richie Berrington comes into the attack.
Length ball, on the pads. Ervine tucks it to deep square leg for a single.
Richie Berrington comes back into the attack.
Flighted ball, down leg. Sean Williams clips it off his pads towards deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Wide! Calum sprays one down leg. Sean Williams misses the sweep and it is called wide.
Tossed up, on middle and leg. Craig Ervine turns it on the leg side for a single.
Leg bye! Quicker ball, darted on the pads. Sean Williams misses the flick and gets hit on the pads. The batters take a quick run as the ball deflects off Sean Williams' pads.
Floated, around middle. Sean Williams works it on the leg side to collect a run.
Bye! Tossed up, on off. Craig Ervine looks to play the reverse sweep but misses and gets rapped on the pads. The batters sneak in a bye!
Tossed up, outside off. Craig Ervine misses the drive and the keeper fails to collect the ball cleanly.
A touch shorter, on middle. Ervine punches it off the back foot for a run.
Flighted ball, on middle. Williams pushes it to wide long on for one.
On off and driven through covers for another one.
FOUR! Lovely cricketing shot from Craig Ervine. Tossed up again, around off and Ervine steps out and just caresses it over extra cover and picks up a boundary.
Tossed up, on middle and Williams works it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Short and wide, cut away to backward point for a quick single.
On middle and blocked out by Williams. The runs are hard to come by at the moment for Zimbabwe.
Length ball, outside off, nicely guided down to third man for one.
LEG BYE! Back of a length, on leg stump. Williams looks to turn it on the leg side but misses. The ball goes off the arms and towards the off side. They sneak in a quick leg bye.
Good-length ball, on middle. Kept out by Williams.
FOUR! Short and wide, Williams latches onto that one and cuts it beautifully past point for a boundary.
Back of a length, around off. This is worked to wide long off for a run.
Flatter delivery, angled in on middle. Blocked out by Sean Williams.
Flighted ball, around off. Williams can't get it past extra cover.
A tad short and on off, punched off the back foot to extra cover.
On off and driven through point for a single.
Slightly tossed up, around off. Ervine looks to cut off the back foot but gets an outside edge towards short third man.
Flatter one, on off and punched to the cover region.
Tossed up, on leg. Sean Williams pushes it back to the bowler.
Tossed up, outside off. Craig Ervine eases it down the ground to collect a single.
Tossed up, on middle. Sean Williams flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Tossed up, outside off. Craig Ervine drives it through cover and takes a run.
Floated, around middle and leg. Craig Ervine turns it on the leg side.
Tossed up, on off. Sean Williams drives it down the ground for a run.
Back of a length, outside off. Craig Ervine taps it towards point. Zimbabwe are 38-3 at the end of the Powerplay.
Good-length ball, on off. Craig Ervine defends it out.
Length ball, on the pads. Sean Williams clips it off his pads towards mid-wicket to collect three runs.
Good-length ball, on off. Sean Williams hits it straight back to the bowler.
FOUR! STREAKY! Good-length ball, on off. Sean Williams looks to drive on the up but gets an inside edge and the ball beats the keeper on his right and races away for a boundary.
Wide! Main sprays down leg. Sean Williams misses the flick. Wided!
Good-length ball, on middle. Sean Williams tucks it towards the left of the bowler.
Back of a length, jagging back in from middle. Sean Williams gets an inside edge onto his pads. The ball rolls away towards backward point and they take one.
Short of a length, outside off. Craig Ervine guides it towards third man for another single.
Good-length ball, on off. Sean Williams pushes it to covers off the back foot for a single.
On a length, outside off. Sean Williams looks to drive on the up but misses.
Length ball, on the pads. Tucked towards fine leg for a run.
Good-length ball, on off. Craig Ervine hangs back and defends it solidly.
Length ball, on off, worked to deep mid-wicket for one.
Another dot ball. On the stumps and kept out by Ervine.
Length ball, on middle and leg. Williams whips it to deep square leg for a run.
On off and this is pushed to the cover region by Williams.
Pitched up on off, driven to cover-point.
FOUR! On the pads, Williams flicks it into the fine leg fence for a welcome boundary.

OUT! RUN OUT! That is the last thing Zimbabwe needed at the moment. This one is outside off and cut away towards cover-point. There is a slight hesitation between the batters and they pay the price. Kyle Coetzer throws it to the bowler, Mark Watt who whips off the bails at the bowler's end. Wesley Madhevere departs.
Length ball, just outside off and this is nudged to short third man.
On middle and worked towards deep mid-wicket for a couple.

OUT! CAUGHT! Regis Chakabva is a goner. Length ball, around off and Chakabva looks to slog it across. He ends up getting a top edge towards backward point where Alasdair Evans takes a simple catch. That's the second one down for Zimbabwe.
Commentary.Howout: c Alasdair Evans b Mark Watt

Commentary.Commentary: Length ball, on the stumps. Chakabva blocks it out.
SIX! In the slot and Regis Chakabva smokes this one back over the bowler's head for a biggie.
Who will come in next?

OUT! This time on a length, around off, Innocent Kaia looks to guide it towards third man, but gets an outside edge to the keeper. EARLY WICKET HERE FOR THE SCOTS! Nothing shot this by Innocent Kaia and he goes back disappointed.
Commentary.Howout: c Matthew Cross b Alasdair Evans

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! This time width outside off, Innocent Kaia cuts it over covers for a boundary. Nice timing on that one. As soon as he saw the width, he lashed onto that one in a flash.
WIDE! This time the bowler tries a short ball. But gets it to bounce way too high over the head of Innocent Kaia to be called a legal delivery.
On a length on middle, Innocent Kaia clips it to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
On a length, around off, extra bounce off the wicket, Regis Chakabva taps it to point for no run.
Short of a length and outside off, the cut shot is missed by the batter.
LEG BYE! Back of a length, on the pads, the batter looks to tuck it away but misses. The ball comes off the thigh pads and rolls onto the leg side. They take a leg bye.
Full ball, on off. Driven towards  mid- off for a quick single.
Back of a length, outside off. Regis Chakabva cuts it towards third man for a run.
Leg bye! Good-length ball, darted on the pads. Kaia misses the flick and gets rapped on the pads. They sneak in a leg bye as the ball rolls away.
Back of a length, on off. Kaia pushes it to cover.
Length ball, outside off. Kaia taps it towards point.
Good-length ball, on off. Kaia defends it off the back foot.

Both teams are out on the middle and we will have the national anthems, starting with the national anthem of Zimbabwe followed by the national anthem of Scotland. Safyaan Sharif to start with the ball.

Both the teams are out for their respective national anthems! Right then! We are done with the national anthems and are set for the game to begin! Scotland's players stride out to the middle. Safyaan Sharif to start with the ball. Innocent Kaia and Regis Chakabva are the openers for Zimbabwe.

Zimbabwe (Playing XI) - Wesley Madhevere, Regis Chakabva (WK), Craig Ervine (C), Sean Williams, Milton Shumba, Ryan Burl, Luke Jongwe, Wellington Masakadza, Tendai Chatara, Richard Ngarava, Innocent Kaia (In for Tadiwanashe Marumani).

Scotland (Unchanged XI) - George Munsey, Kyle Coetzer (C), Oliver Hairs, Richie Berrington, Calum MacLeod, Matthew Cross (WK), Michael Leask, Safyaan Sharif, Mark Watt, Gavin Main (In for Chris Sole), Alasdair Evans.
TOSS - Up goes the coin and it lands in favor of Zimbabwe. They elect to bat first.

Hello and welcome to the 2nd T20I between Scotland and Zimbabwe. The hosts edged their opponents by 7 runs in the first match, courtesy of some really good death bowling and will look to wrap up the series today itself. The visitors, on the other hand, will look to improve on their middle order collapse and stay in the series with a win. Who will win? We shall find out soon, but first, the toss and team news in a bit.
